The subject wears a floral wreath, a white blouse with embroidery, and a blue patterned bodice. Colorful ribbons (red, yellow, green) extend from the top of the frame downwards, indicating the presence of the maypole structure above. In the background, other dancers and spectators are visible on a grassy field with trees.
